objective: Complete APW Implementation Handoff and Stage/Internal-Alpha Integration by converting APW-01 through APW-07, CSW-10 and APM-06 into one dependency-ordered application implementation package with explicit owning domains, migration/change inventory, additive touch-point map, feature flags/fallbacks, deterministic fixtures/validators, Internal Alpha amendments, roadmap placement and Stage A non-reopening rules.

What exact persistence and migration/change inventory is required and which existing domain migrations/contracts are reused rather than replaced?

What exact additive touch-point map covers identity/dashboard/context, Campaign/Scene/Session, Action/approval, recovery, downtime/crafting, investigation/social, World/Adventure/creator, notifications/visibility and automated play?
How should APW-I01 through APW-I07 be finalized and dependency-ordered against CSW-I01 through CSW-I08 and APM-I01 through APM-I06?
Which feature flags, fallbacks and no-AI/zero-paid-service paths are required for staged Internal Alpha adoption?
What deterministic fixtures and validators prove live→async→GM resolution→Player return→live continuation, Personal/Workshop/creator flows and automated-play recovery?
What UI/screen/navigation acceptance amendments are required after APW-06 and CSW-09 while preserving accessibility/mobile/nonvisual parity?
What compatibility/rollback rules preserve existing Stage A contracts and avoid broad migration rewrites?
What Internal Alpha scope and implementation order provides the maximum infrastructure leverage across APW, CSW and APM?
What exact roadmap placement should activate implementation after this handoff, and what remains planning-only until that activation?
What completion evidence must exist before implementation work can claim a tranche complete?
What explicit non-reopening rule prevents this handoff from invalidating already completed Stage A milestones?

After APW-08 completes, what current roadmap item should the canonical selector move to, considering T04 remains owner-deferred until September, WP-011 is special-environment dormant and DS-008 is blocked non-owner?

Stage A reopening without independent regression evidence
